mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS cartItemId, c.user_id AS userId, c.sku_id AS skuId, s.product_id AS productId, p.name AS productName, p.main_image AS mainImage, s.price AS skuPrice, c.quantity AS quantity, c.quantity * s.price AS cartAmount, c.create_time AS addTime, u.phone AS userPhone, u.openid AS userOpenid FROM cart_item c JOIN product_sku s ON s.id = c.sku_id AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND s.status = 1 JOIN product p ON p.id = s.product_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1 JOIN `user` u ON u.id = c.user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.status = 1 WHERE c.is_deleted = 0 AND c.quantity >= #{minQuantity} AND c.create_time <= #{idleBefore} AND c.create_time >= #{idleAfter} AND c.id > #{lastId} ORDER BY c.id ASC LIMIT #{batchSize}

SELECT t.product_id AS productId, t.product_name AS productName, COUNT(DISTINCT t.user_id) AS abandonUserCnt, COUNT(*) AS abandonItemCnt, SUM(LEAST(t.quantity, #{qtyCap}) * t.sku_price) AS abandonAmount, COALESCE(paid.paid_user_cnt, 0) AS paidUserCnt FROM cart_recall_target t LEFT JOIN ( SELECT oi.product_id AS product_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.user_id) AS paid_user_cnt FROM order_item oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE oi.is_deleted = 0 AND o.is_deleted = 0 AND o.status IN (2, 3, 4) AND o.create_time >= #{paidFrom} GROUP BY oi.product_id ) paid ON paid.product_id = t.product_id WHERE t.stat_date = #{statDate} GROUP BY t.product_id, t.product_name ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT t.user_id) DESC, t.product_id ASC
SELECT c.user_id FROM cart_item c WHERE c.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY c.user_id HAVING COUNT(*) > #{maxCartSize}

SELECT #{statDate} AS statDate, COUNT(*) AS totalItems, COUNT(DISTINCT t.user_id) AS totalUsers, COALESCE(SUM(t.cart_amount), 0) AS totalAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.reachable = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reachableItems, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.reachable = 1 THEN t.user_id END) AS reachableUsers, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.user_phone IS NOT NULL AND t.user_phone <> '' THEN t.user_id END) AS phoneUsers, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.user_openid IS NOT NULL AND t.user_openid <> '' THEN t.user_id END) AS openidUsers, COALESCE(AVG(t.idle_hours), 0) AS avgIdleHours, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pendingItems, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sentItems, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS convertedItems FROM cart_recall_target t WHERE t.stat_date = #{statDate}
